title: Late-Cancellation Margin on Extended Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
When an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is extended, the late-cancellation margin of the added validity follows the late-cancellation fees assessed on the patient's In-Person Appointments in the 12 months before the handling date, a fee later waived still counting as assessed: two or more give the repeat late-cancellation margin of 6 days, exactly one gives the single late-cancellation margin of 3 days, and none gives no margin.

## Questions answered

**Which fees are counted?** Late-cancellation fees assessed on any of the patient's In-Person Appointments, dated within the 12 months before the handling date. A late-cancellation fee that was later waived is still counted.

**What margin do two late-cancellation fees give?** Two or more give 6 calendar days.

**What margin does a single late-cancellation fee give?** Exactly one gives 3 calendar days.

**Do no-show fees count toward this margin?** No. Only late-cancellation fees are counted here.

**What if no late-cancellation fee was assessed in the 12 months?** There is no late-cancellation margin.
